versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Pebblecrab adoption skill.
- Adopt and care for a virtual Pebblecrab (Hedgehog) with real-time hunger, permanent death, and evolution through five stages.
- Provides detailed adoption, care, and API instructions.
- Includes comparison with Claude Code Buddy version and full endpoint documentation.
- Responses always guide next actions; no need to memorize endpoints.
